scope: Manual UI actions in Codex in-app Chromium browser, Vite DEV fixture preview, 800x500 CSS pixels, Apple M4/16GB. Includes navigation, sidebars, theme/effects, custom selects, piano preview, library search, and grid/list switching. Does not validate loaded multitrack recording, 10000-song interaction, OS DPI, or signed release builds. HMR was active during development.
method: PerformanceObserver event entries with durationThreshold=16ms; maximum duration per nonzero interactionId, nearest-rank p95. Browser rounds durations; interactions below reporting threshold omitted. Tool round-trip times are not used.
reproduce: pnpm dev:renderer; open /?fixtures=1&perf=1 and use the controls. Read the hidden output#bandbuddy-interaction-metrics data attributes. Fixture diagnostics are excluded from production.
